study: Olson et al. 2020, Pathway Project scale-up (4 NWP sites RCT), J. Educational Psychology
delivery_evidence: Intensive 46-hour PD delivered in person via six full-day released days plus five 2-hour after-school sessions, plus coaching (Method: 'six full-day released days... and five 2-hour after-school'); 'online' in the paper refers only to journal supplementary materials, not PD mode.
test_alignment_evidence: Included outcomes are the researcher/developer-made NWP Analytic Writing Continuum-Literary Analysis (AWC-LA) on-demand writing assessment (researcher_made) and the Smarter Balanced (SBAC) state standardized ELA test (standardized_independent).
curriculum_evidence: Treatment addresses educational challenges 'by providing teachers with curriculum materials and instructional [strategies]'; PD bundles the Pathway cognitive-strategies curriculum materials/tool kit that teachers use (Method).
outcome_timing_evidence: Impact analyses use the end-of-Year-1 wave (immediate post; outcomes standardized within cohort/prompt) (extraction notes; Results).
